newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish budget deficit 720 trillion lira in H1.
newsitem.headline: Turkish budget deficit 720 trillion lira in H1.

text.p: Turkey's budget deficit for the first half of 1997 is 720 trillion lira, according to a document to be read out to parliament on Monday by new Prime Minister Mesut Yilmaz.
The previous government had predicted a balanced budget this year.
The previous government of former prime minister Necmettin Erbakan had predicted a balanced budget this year.
"In the first months of the year the budget balance has shown a deficit of hundreds of trillions of liras and has reached the 720 trillion lira mark," the document said.
The document, to form the basis of the new government's policies, also vowed to speed up the privatisation of the banking sector.
It said the government would increase revenues by widening the tax base and lowering some tax rates.
